channel.description: Maps, explainers, and notes on environmental planning in Florida.

item.title: Why I’m putting my research out in the open
item.description:
Most research ends up in a journal article or a conference talk that a few hundred people see. But the questions I work on, like how growth reaches rural counties, who lives with environmental burdens, and what’s happening to Florida’s water, belong to everyone who lives here.

So this is where I’ll share the work as it happens.

What to expect:

  • Maps with plain-language notes
  • Explainers on Florida planning
  • Research updates
  • Reading picks from the news and journals

If you want somewhere to start, try the maps.
